See deals *Requires advance ordering. Pricing does not include tax. Frequently Asked Questions Is Publix open on Easter? No. We will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5. We will resume our regular store hours on Monday, April 6. Does Publix have Easter brunch options? Yes. If you’re serving brunch for Easter this year, our platters are a great way to offer your guests a variety of their favorites. Order ahead for in-store pickup. 24 hours advanced notice is required. Our fresh fruit platter comes with a variety of seasonal fruit, including grapes, strawberries, apples, pineapple, and melons. It pairs well with ourJeweled Brie Platter, which is made with fresh French Brie that is glazed with peach preserves and honey, and topped with sliced almonds and cranberries. This platter comes with seedless grapes, sliced applies, strawberries, and crackers for dipping. Complete your Easter brunch with ham and eggs—pick up a Publix Brown Sugar Spiral Sliced Hamand a platter of our popular deviled eggsmade with egg white halves, deviled egg filling, and black olive slices. Does Publix have Easter dinners? Yes. Publix offers a variety of Easter dinners from the Deli starting at less than $10 per person.*Convenient and delicious, our dinners come cooked and ready to heat. If you’re looking for a traditional Easter meal, we recommend ourSliced Ham Dinner. It’s$69.99, serves 7, and comes with: 1 fully cooked boneless ham (approximately 5 lbs) 2.25 lbs of sweet potato casserole 2 lbs of green bean casserole 26 ozmarshmallow delight The Turkey Dinner with Rice and Plantains is another popular choice for Easter. It is $69.99, serves 8,and comes with: 1 fully cooked 9.5–12.5lb turkey 2 lbs of sweet plantains 2 lbs of rice with pigeon peas 32 oz gravy 16 ozof cranberry orange relish 1Dulce de Leche Milk-Infused Bar Cake For larger gatherings, we suggest the Publix Large Turkey Dinner. It is $139.99, serves 15, and comes with: 1 fully cooked 16–18 lb turkey 5 lbs of old-fashioned cornbread dressing 5 lbs of homestyle Yukon Gold mashed potatoes 52 oz of marshmallow delight 64 oz of gravy 32 oz of cranberry orange relish What Easter cakes and desserts does Publix carry? Our beautiful, hand-decorated cakes make the perfect centerpiece for your holiday table. Choose from traditional Easter cakes like our elegant Carrot Cake Cheesecake. To make this delicious dessert, we ice carrot cake and a whole New York–style cheesecakewith whipped cream topping and decorate it with swirls of cream cheese icing, buttercream carrots, and toasted pecans.Our Carrot Torte Cake is also an excellent choice for your Easter dessert table. It’s made with four layers of carrot cake that are filled and frosted with cream cheese icing and decorated with fudge piping, toasted pecans, and buttercream carrots.Both cakes go well with our Southern banana pudding ice cream, made with French-style custard ice cream, swirls of banana sauce, and bits of vanilla wafers. Does Publix have Easter candy? Yes. We have everything you need to fill your Easter baskets with chocolate bunnies, jelly beans, and other Easter candy. From Easter brunch and Easter dinners to Easter eggs and candy, Publix has everything you need to make your celebration festive and delicious. 2,000 calories a day is used for general nutrition advice, but calorie needs vary.
